subject: ProcureX pilot onboarding — PO requirement and temporary invoice path
messages:
From: Rachel Smith <r.smith@procurex.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: ProcureX Accounts <accounts@procurex.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ProcureX pilot onboarding — PO requirement

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for choosing ProcureX for the pilot. To begin onboarding we need to confirm procurement requirements on our side. Our standard policy requires a purchase order (PO) from customers before we activate billing/entitlements.

I attached our Vendor Onboarding / PO Guide for reference (ProcureX_Onboarding_PO_Guide.pdf). Practically, that means accounts cannot be provisioned until we have a PO number in our system.

If your procurement team requires an exception process, we can consider a short-term invoice-only path for trials but that requires approval from our legal and finance teams. Can you share the approval cadence on your side and any documentation (COI, W9) to help expedite?

Looking forward to your thoughts — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Rachel Smith
Partnerships Manager
ProcureX

Attachments:
- ProcureX_Onboarding_PO_Guide.pdf (pdf)
From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Smith <r.smith@procurex.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ProcureX pilot onboarding — PO requirement

Rachel —

Appreciate the clarity. We're eager to get the pilot running this month, and a hard PO requirement will slow the launch significantly. Our usual path for early pilots is:
- sign a short SOW (scope/terms)
- allow invoice-only for the first 60–90 days with capped spend

I understand ProcureX needs to mitigate risk. On our side, we can provide COI, W9, and a signed SOW immediately. Would ProcureX accept an invoice-only path capped at $20,000 for the pilot while legal completes the PO process? If so, we can route an internal exception.

CC'ing Laura and Lauren from Finance to confirm what documentation Redwood needs to authorize an exception.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---
On Thu, Nov 5, 2026 at 9:12 AM Rachel Smith <r.smith@procurex.com> wrote:
> Hi Markus,
> 
> Thanks again for choosing ProcureX for the pilot....
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Rachel Smith <r.smith@procurex.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 16:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ProcureX pilot onboarding — PO requirement

Markus / Rachel —

Thanks for looping me in. Finance is generally willing to support temporary invoice-only arrangements for pilot engagements under a few conditions to manage exposure:

1) Maximum pilot cap: $25,000 total (we can accept up to $25k given this is a short evaluation).
2) Documentation: COI, W9, and a signed SOW that explicitly lists the $ cap and deliverables.
3) Payment terms: Net 15 for pilot invoices.
4) Approval: An internal exception form needs to be completed and signed by my manager (I can start that).

If ProcureX legal requires a PO for production, we accept that and will work to obtain one before expansion. For now, if ProcureX can confirm acceptance of those four points we will:
- sign the SOW once DocuSign is sent
- complete and submit the Redwood Exception Request (attached)

Rachel, can you confirm whether ProcureX Finance can accept Net 15 invoice terms for the pilot and whether any additional vendor onboarding fields (tax ID, remit address) are required?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Finance Director
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Redwood_Exception_Request_Form.pdf (pdf)
From: Rachel Smith <r.smith@procurex.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: ProcureX Accounts <accounts@procurex.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ProcureX pilot onboarding — PO requirement

Hi all,

Thanks for the quick responses and the proposed path. I checked with our finance and legal teams. Short summary of where we can flex:

- Legal: requires a PO for production contracts and ongoing subscriptions.
- Finance: can accept an invoice-only path for pilots but only up to $10,000 without a PO; for anything above $10k a PO is required or we need an explicit finance-to-finance approval email thread.

Given that gap, we can offer the following compromise to keep momentum:
1) Proceed with SOW execution via DocuSign (I attached SOW v2) and sign-off on scope.
2) Pilot will be invoice-only with Net 15, capped at $10,000.
3) If you need the $20k/$25k range, ProcureX requires a formal PO or a signed finance approval (ProcureX can accept an internal approval email that names the approver and commit).

Please see attached: ProcureX_SOW_v2.docx (contains scope + pilot cap language). If you accept the $10k cap, I will route the SOW for signature today and ProcureX Accounts will send the first invoice on completion of milestone 1.

On logistics: we will need Redwood's tax ID and remit address for the invoice. Also — happy to set up a 15-min sync if you want to escalate.

Best,
Rachel Smith
Partnerships Manager
ProcureX

Attachments:
- ProcureX_SOW_v2.docx (docx)
From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Smith <r.smith@procurex.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ProcureX pilot onboarding — PO requirement

Rachel —

Thanks for checking and for the clear compromise. Redwood accepts the $10k invoice-only cap to keep the pilot timeline intact. Next steps from our side:

1) We will review and sign the SOW via your DocuSign link (please route it).
2) Laura will submit the internal exception form and route to her manager for sign-off (I copied Grace from Sales Ops to track the rollout).
3) I will send Redwood's remit and tax info to ProcureX Accounts after the SOW is signed.

Two asks for ProcureX to keep the pilot low friction: please add explicit language in the SOW that this is a time-boxed pilot (30 days) with a $10,000 cap and that a PO will be required for any production expansion. That will make internal approvals trivial.

Happy to jump on a quick call Monday if useful — otherwise please send the DocuSign and we'll execute.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
